ceramic.snippet:
EXTREME NETWORKS INC (EXTR) — StockWatch

      EXTREME NETWORKS INC P/L Snapshot

  Extreme Networks reported strong financial results for its fourth quarter and fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. FY26 revenue increased 13% year-over-year to $1.28 billion, marking the sixth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. SaaS ARR grew 17.7% year-over-year to $244.3 million, driven by accelerating demand for its AI platform and strong execution. The company also announced a new $500 million revolving credit facility and provided positive guidance for Q1 and full-year fiscal 2027, expecting continued double-digit product revenue growth and strong EPS.

  Extreme Networks, Inc. entered into a new Credit Agreement on July 29, 2026, establishing a 5-year revolving loan facility totaling $500 million. This new facility replaces the companys previous credit agreement from June 2023.

  Extreme Networks reported strong financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026, with net income surging by 206% to $10.6 million and total net revenues increasing by 11.4% to $316.9 million. Diluted EPS rose to $0.08 from $0.03 year-over-year. For the nine-month period, net income saw a substantial increase to $24.1 million. The company also repurchased $62.0 million in common stock during the nine months ended March 31, 2026.

  Extreme Networks reported strong third quarter fiscal year 2026 financial results, with revenue increasing 11% year-over-year to $316.9 million and SaaS Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) accelerating 28.6% year-over-year to $236.4 million. This marks the companys fifth straight quarter of double-digit growth and eighth consecutive quarter of sequential product revenue growth, driven by demand for its AI-powered platform and successful supply chain management. Extreme also returned $50 million to shareholders through an accelerated share repurchase program, underscoring confidence in its operating model and cash flow generation.

Extreme Networks delivered its seventh consecutive quarter of revenue growth, with Q2 FY26 revenue of $318M (+14% YoY), exceeding guidance. Gross margin reached 62%, and EPS rose 24% YoY to $0.26. Management raised full-year revenue guidance and expects profit to outpace revenue growth, driven by strong SaaS momentum, competitive wins, and robust demand across all regions.

Our fully diluted share count is expected to be around 136 million shares.
